status: proposed protocol; no purchase or trial performed
objective: Simultaneous groomed new-snow glide and edge behavior at about50C, rain restoration within60min, winter connection, safety and whole-life cost

candidate_families.route: thermal conditioning before final classification and contact assembly
candidate_families.stop_or_pivot: conditioning destroys branches or re-cooling creates unstable contacts

candidate_families.route: separate open support skeleton and replaceable local contact phase
candidate_families.stop_or_pivot: wear safety friction or winter load-path fail despite support stability

temperature_histories.source_reference: 20C crystallization is a research control, not achievement of30C+ formation
temperature_histories.actual_temperatures: select after observing branch stability;80/100C not automatically recommended
temperature_histories.reason: groom interval and operating day;not service-life validation

measurements: DSC paired with same-particle hot-stage microscopy
independence and branch thickness/length/void geometry after extraction
real ski sole friction and edge support/cutting/release
particle mass-size distribution and fines after wet recovery
drainage and winter snow-to-ground load path
finished formulation leachate residues exposure wear particles
controls: same formulation and lot across process histories
natural groomed new-snow reference with snow temperature density ski speed and load recorded
pass_criteria: Predefine quantitative tolerances against the measured reference before testing; no numerical success criteria invented from this study
maintenance: 60minutes includes deployment redistribution rebonding and QA; measure after realistic rain-induced sorting
cost: Separate material mass, shape yield, removal, conditioning, classification, replacement and equipment budget;1%local treatment is only sensitivity
